records.title: 这颗星星送给你
records.actual_mj_prompt: First-person seated view angled gently downward beside a single Japanese schoolgirl on a wooden stage edge. Her face remains visible in the upper-right, while her upturned palm presents one small cream-colored folded paper star near the center foreground. She glances from the star toward the viewer with a shy closed-mouth smile. The viewer's right hand enters only from the bottom-left, palm open beneath hers, about to receive the star; the star still rests on her palm, with a clear gap between the two hands. Loose black hair reaches mid-back and falls over her shoulder, wispy bangs leaving her eyes readable. She wears a white short-sleeved sailor blouse with a navy collar and a navy pleated skirt. Warm fading window light touches the paper and fingers, against deep olive-green and cool teal gymnasium shadows. Natural warm skin, creamy whites, softly layered focus and extremely subtle grain. records.translation_zh: 第一人称坐姿，视线微向下，从身旁望向一名坐在木舞台边缘的日本女学生。脸位于右上方，掌心朝上，在前景中央托着一颗奶油白折纸星。她从纸星望向你，羞涩抿嘴微笑。你的右手仅从左下角伸入，张开掌心准备接住；纸星仍在她掌上，双手间留有明确空隙。黑色散发长至背中部，垂过肩头；轻薄刘海不遮眼。她穿白色短袖水手服、海军蓝领口及百褶裙。渐弱的暖窗光照亮纸星和手指，背景是体育馆深橄榄绿与冷青蓝阴影。肤色自然温暖，白色柔润，焦点层次柔和，颗粒极轻。岩井俊二风格的青春电影剧照，一份带着意外温柔递出的微小纪念。
